description: Cross-chain token swap powered by Li.Fi across 70+ chains incl. Hyperliquid. USE WHEN: bridge, fund gas, treasury routing, or rebalance. RETURNS: Li.Fi route + execution_readiness + swap_actions_v1. Prefer signing swap_actions_v1 in order. MCP free; on-chain swap costs gas + HyperNatt 0.25% integrator fee (Li.Fi may add its own cut — read quote.estimate.feeCosts). Side effects: MCP read-only until wallet signs.

fromAmount.description: Amount in token smallest units (wei for 18-decimal tokens)

fromChain.description: Source Li.Fi chain id (e.g. 1 Ethereum, 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum)

fromToken.description: Source token contract address on fromChain

toToken.description: Destination token contract address on toChain

name: swap_via_nattswap
